      How to use Work Desk

      Quick start
      1. Sign in with your email to sync across devices, or choose Continue offline to keep everything in this browser.
      2. Pick a day on the calendar, or use the arrows above the desk.
      3. Choose Task or Note, type it (add #tagname anywhere to tag it), and click Add.
      4. Click a task's left edge to complete it. Everything saves on its own.
      Cards & columns
      • Columns — tasks move through New, Active, and Completed / Shelved; notes have their own area. The bar above the board shows today's mix (hover for counts)
      • Complete button — click or tap a task's left edge; click again to reopen. Pick another edge style, or a checkbox, in Options → Appearance → Card layout
      • Action bar — edit, move (to another day), comment (add update on notes), and tag. Double-click a card to edit it
      • Overflow menu (⋮) — Start, Shelve / Unshelve, Send to Work or Personal, Send to project…, Convert to note or task, and Delete. Undo in the toast brings back what you deleted
      • Shelve — for a task that isn't done but isn't today's focus; it waits under Shelved until you unshelve it
      • Drag — move tasks between columns or reorder within one (on touch screens, press and drag). On desktop the space below a column also takes the drop, and a dashed strip shows where it lands
      • Carry forward — the button appears when earlier days left tasks open. Turn on Auto carry each day in Options → Behavior to do it automatically
      • Formatting — click Aa next to the add box for bold, italic, underline, and bullets
      • Completed tasks fade and get a strikethrough (Options → Behavior → Tasks); hover to read them
      Tags
      • Add — type #word anywhere while writing, or click tag; your two most-used tags show up as one-click picks. #ACE and #ace are the same tag
      • Remove — click the × on a chip
      • Tag colors — Options → Appearance → Tags: Single color (accent) (default), Shades of accent (colors that match the screen), or Multi-color (a wider set that suits the theme). Your most-used tags get the most distinct colors and keep them on every device. Click a chip to pin your own color; Reset to auto removes it
      • Tag position — Options → Appearance → Card layout: Own row (default), Slim headroom, or Action bar
      • Find — search #tagname to see every tagged task and note
      Comments & updates
      • Click comment on a task, or add update on a note, for a timestamped thread with bold, italic, underline, and bullets
      • Hover a comment for edit, delete, → task, and → note. Splitting one off keeps the tags, links back to the original, and can be undone
      • Keep comments open (Options → Behavior) lets several threads stay open, even across days and refreshes
      Recurring tasks
      • Open the Recurring tab next to Task and Note in the add form. Type the task, pick a schedule from Repeats, and press Add
      • Each row shows the schedule and when it's next due; * marks one that skips holidays
      • Schedules: Daily, Weekdays, Weekly, Custom days, Every 2 weeks (from a start date), Monthly, and Quarterly
      • Monthly and Quarterly — Day of month picks dates (the 1st and 15th, or Last; a 29th–31st falls on the last day of shorter months). Day of week picks weeks and a weekday (the 3rd Thursday, or the 1st and 3rd Tuesday). Quarterly also asks which months
      • When they appear — a due task is added to today when the app opens, syncs, or you switch desks, once per day, so deleting or completing it won't bring it back. Days the app wasn't opened aren't filled in afterward
      • Recurring tasks show a badge. Tags on a template carry to every task, and Skip holidays skips federal and custom holidays
      • Edit, tag, or delete — use a row's ⋮ menu in the Recurring panel, or Edit recurring in a recurring task's ⋮ menu. The panel flags templates with the same text
      Projects
      • Click Projects in the sidebar, then +. Each project has Notes and Tasks tabs
      • Cards work like the desk: the same editor, tags, comments, and complete edge. Double-click to edit
      • Archive — archive moves an item into the collapsed Archived list; completing a task archives it, and reopening brings it back
      • Pin and reorder — pin keeps a project at the top; drag projects, notes, and tasks to reorder them, or press Alt+↑ / ↓
      • More menu — Copy as Markdown (for Jira, Confluence, or Slack), Archive project, and Move up / Move down. Rename and Delete sit beside it
      • to desk sends an item to Work or Personal on the day you pick; Send to project… on a desk card goes the other way. Undo puts it back
      Navigation & search
      • Calendar — dots mark days with data, and yellow badges count tasks left open on past days. The Today chip beside the month jumps back
      • Arrows step a day at a time, and Back to today returns. On narrow screens, or with the sidebar at the top or bottom, a week strip replaces the calendar
      • On launch — the app reopens your last desk and day; change it with Open desk and On launch in Options → Behavior → General
      • Search — the sidebar box matches text, comments, and #tags on every day. The scope chip switches between Work, Personal, and All (All includes Projects). Click a result to jump to it
      • What's new — a link under the subtitle means there's an update; the version in the account menu opens the changelog any time
      Insights
      • Pick Week, Month, or Year; the arrows step back, and This week (or month or year) returns
      • Summary — completion rate, average completions, carry-over rate, most productive day, and a comparison with the period before
      • Tasks by Tag, Lingering Tasks (oldest open), and Shelved Review, where Bring back moves a task to today's Active column
      • Recurring Follow-through shows how often each recurring task got done on the days it came up (days you didn't open the desk don't count); under 50% after 3 or more chances gets a Rarely done flag
      • Carry Chains lists tasks carried forward 3 or more times, with Shelve to park one that keeps slipping. Carries are counted from 1.23.0 on
      • Tag Trend compares each tag's share of your tasks with the period before (to the same point if this one isn't over). It needs 10 tasks on each side before showing arrows
      • Carry-over analysis shows when tasks were left unfinished, with the dates behind each weekday (e.g. Wed: Sep 9 (2) · Sep 23 (1))
      • Streaks come with a heatmap. Weekends don't break streaks unless you turn that off in Options → Behavior → Insights
      • Charts switch between bar, line, stacked, and pie. Click a day in the table, chart, or heatmap to open it on the desk
      • The Month chart stops at today, and with Quieter weekends on for that desk it leaves out empty Saturdays and Sundays; a note under the legend says how many and links to the setting
      Options
      • Open with ⚙ near the date or Options in the account menu. Each tab opens on a short list; click a row to open it, and ‹ Back or Esc to return
      • Themes — 108 presets (36 light, 36 medium, 36 dark) with previews and a Light/Med/Dark filter, plus up to 5 Custom themes from 5 colors
      • Appearance — card layout, text size and font, sidebar position (left, right, top, or bottom), effects, a patterned background, and tag colors
      • Behavior — startup, week start, quieter weekends, full screen, comments, auto-collapse and auto carry, confetti, delete confirmation, strikethrough, long notes, and holidays (US federal plus your own dates)
      • Reset to defaults at the bottom of a tab resets just that tab; your theme, pinned tag colors, and custom holidays stay. A New tag marks settings from the latest release
      Sync, backup & storage
      • Signed in, changes sync a few seconds after you edit, and devices merge rather than overwrite. When the same task was changed on two devices, the most recent change wins. Deleting removes an item everywhere, and Undo brings it back everywhere. Your settings sync too
      • Continue offline keeps data in this browser only, so clearing site data erases it. Use Sign in to sync in the account menu when you're ready
      • Account menu — the button at the bottom of the sidebar shows sync status (☁️ / 🔄 / ✓ / !) and holds Options, Help, What's new, Export, Import, Repair duplicates, Sign in / Sign out, and the version
      • Export and Import — Desk covers the tab you're on; All Desks bundles Work, Personal, and Projects. Importing asks whether to Merge with your data or Replace it
      • Repair duplicates cleans up copies that sync may have left behind
      • Browser storage holds about 5 MB; at 80% full a banner suggests Export All. While you type, incoming changes wait until you click away
      • When a new version ships while the app is open, a message offers Reload
      Phone & install
      • Install — use your browser's install option, or on iPhone Share → Add to Home Screen. Installed, it opens in its own window and works offline
      • Phone menu — the top bar keeps your tabs (Desk and Insights, with Work, Personal, and Projects underneath), search, and Help; the menu button holds your account, backup, Options, and What's new. The dot beside it shows sync status
      • The add bar stays at the bottom, the week strip picks the day, and a task's left edge is wider for tapping (a bit narrower on a tablet in landscape)
      • Full screen — Options → Behavior → General hides the status bar and app tray on that device only; swipe from an edge to see them
      Keyboard shortcuts
      • Start a new task / note — T / N (when you aren't typing in a box)
      • Previous / next day — [ / ]
      • Add a task, note, or comment — Ctrl/Cmd + Enter
      • Save an edit (task, note, comment, or recurring task) — Ctrl/Cmd + Enter
      • Bold / Italic / Underline — Ctrl/Cmd + B / I / U
      • Reorder a project, note, or project task — Alt + ↑ / ↓
      • Move around a menu — ↑ / ↓
      • Cancel an edit, close a menu, or leave the add box — Escape
